package stock
 Given
  export Widget { title:text }
  policy Widget read=members
 When
  crud Widget by=members fields=title
 Then
app Targets
use stock {Widget as Item}
Given
 contract References { local:action(mutate), update:action(Item.update), delete:action(Item.delete), create:action(Item.create) }
When
 scenario mutate(record:Item, amount:decimal=1.50) by=members
  do
   let amountCopy = amount
 scenario descriptors(record:Item) read=true -> References by=members
  do
   return {local=action(bindings={record=record},target=mutate),update=action(Item.update,{record=record}),delete=action(Item.delete,{record=record}),create=action(Item.create,{})}
 scenario empty() by=members
  do
   let value = 1
 scenario defaults() read=true -> action(empty) by=members
  do
   return action(empty,{})
Then
